name: Cavalryman's Bow
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 22
Aura moderate conjuration CL 8th
Slot none; Price 10,330 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This +2 shortbow is etched with equine imagery. Whenever the bow is fired from a mount, the wielder’s mount gains a +2 deflection bonus to its AC until the start of the wielder’s next turn.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield of faith, warp wood; Price 5,330 gp
